description: Build a full-spectrum block-Lanczos eigensolver for dense n=512 and n=1024 batches. Generate a complete 32/64-column Krylov basis with BF16/TF32 tensor-core A*V and block recurrences, selective FP32 reorthogonalization or compact-WY/CQR, solve the resulting block-tridiagonal projection, and backtransform with tensor cores. Explore persistent TMA producer/consumer pipelining and residual-driven early cleanup; retain a per-matrix FP32 residual gate and cuSOLVER fallback.

Complete 64-column block-Lanczos/Arnoldi basis on homogeneous dense n=512: TF32 A-panel products, two-pass FP32 full reorthogonalization, batched cluster projected solve, FP32 backtransform, residual gate. Validation 39/39; shape3 167912.257 us; geomean 26953.759 us.

Replaced the 119.8 ms cluster projected eigensolve with tensor-core matrix-sign divide-and-conquer. Validation 39/39 and small-batch dense residual improved, but b640 shape3 rose to 312174.795 us (consistent with sign-route mass fallback or wide-spectrum iteration cost); geomean 28287.111 us.

Solved the complete block-Lanczos projection with cuSOLVER instead of cluster or sign backends. Validation 39/39; shape3 204714.626 us; geomean 27394.789 us. This bounds the basis plus backtransform overhead against the serial dense projected solve.

Split the block-tridiagonal Lanczos projection into two independent 256-wide megakernel leaves at the midpoint panel boundary. Validation 39/39 via the residual safety path; omitted rank-64 boundary coupling forced fallback at scale, yielding shape3 273154.104 us and geomean 27997.746 us.

Widened the correct cluster-backed full-spectrum Lanczos basis from 64 to 128 columns, halving panel count. Validation 39/39; larger CQR/trsm panels outweighed fewer stages and shape3 measured 180213.852 us; geomean 27126.240 us.

Restored 64-column panels and moved both full reorthogonalization and final basis backtransform from true FP32 to FP32-accurate 3xTF32 tensor-core products. Validation 39/39; the three-product compensation plus extra materialization exceeded the SIMT cost, shape3 186143.209 us, geomean 27214.870 us.

Used two plain-TF32 projection/refinement passes for full-basis reorthogonalization and restored the FP32 backtransform. Validation 39/39, but reduced projected-matrix accuracy increased scale-batch fallback/solver error; shape3 232422.688 us and geomean 27646.854 us.

Moved the FP32-coefficient 64-column full-spectrum block-Lanczos route to homogeneous dense n=1024 (k608 PR class), using a complete 16-panel basis and C=5 projected cluster solve. Validation 39/39; dense1024 shape4 measured 179203.766 us versus the parent low-rank route around 44 ms; geomean 28192.961 us.

Measured complete 32-column block-Lanczos panels at n=512 with true-FP32 two-pass reorthogonalization and cluster projected solve. Validation 39/39; narrower CQR kernels nearly offset twice the stage count, shape3 169159.332 us versus 167912.257 us at block64; geomean 26985.755 us.

Ran all Lanczos A*panel products with BF16 inputs/FP32 accumulation at block64, retaining true-FP32 full reorthogonalization/backtransform and the residual gate. Validation 39/39; conversion plus reduced projected accuracy outweighed tensor throughput, shape3 169938.126 us versus TF32 167912.257 us; geomean 27003.127 us.

Converted full block Arnoldi reorthogonalization into two-pass selective block Lanczos against only the current/previous 64-column panels, explicitly producing a block-tridiagonal projection. Validation remained 39/39 through fallback, but loss of global orthogonality caused scale-batch full fallback: shape3 378470.917 us, geomean 28709.951 us.

Added consolidated two-pass full-basis CQR (3xTF32 then TF32) after window-2 Lanczos, recomputed the full Rayleigh projection, and retained the outer gate. Validation 39/39 via fallback; the selective basis was too ill-conditioned for cheap global cleanup and shape3 measured 401866.079 us, geomean 28839.477 us.

Restored full-history FP32 reorthogonalization but reduced it from two passes to one, relying on per-panel CQR. Validation 39/39 through fallback; one pass did not suppress late-panel ghost components, shape3 378638.316 us and geomean 28724.777 us.

Restored two full-history FP32 projections but reduced each 64-column panel normalization to one CQR pass. Validation 39/39 and the small validation batch stayed custom; scale-batch conditioning induced partial fallback, shape3 233620.717 us and geomean 27656.927 us.

Used conditioning-gated CQR2 for every 64-column panel: all matrices receive one pass and only predicted-hard panels receive pass two, while retaining two full-history FP32 projections. Validation 39/39; shape3 improved from the unconditional-CQR 167912.257 to 163699.468 us, branch best; geomean 26912.037 us.

Relaxed the conditioned-CQR second-pass threshold from 1.0x to 1.5x the orthogonality gate. Validation 39/39; panel decisions and shape3 timing were effectively unchanged at 163909.409 us versus 163699.468 us, while noisy unrelated shapes produced geomean 26972.863 us.

Executed 16 logged full-spectrum block-Lanczos trials. Best branch result is 53c402b2d at 26912.037 us (39/39): complete 64-column basis, TF32 A*V, two full-history FP32 reorth passes, conditioning-gated CQR2, C=2 cluster projected solve, FP32 backtransform; dense512 was 163.699 ms. Unconditional CQR was 167.912 ms; block32/128 were 169.159/180.214 ms; BF16 A*V 169.938 ms; n1024 complete basis 179.204 ms; cuSOLVER/sign/2-leaf projection variants 204.715/312.175/273.154 ms; selective/windowed, one-pass reorth, and global-CQR cleanup caused fallback. Final profile 362f51312 shows projected mega_eigh_clust_split_k 120.017 ms (75%); Lanczos/reorth/backtransform are the remaining ~40 ms. Keep this direction moving: a true block-banded-to-tridiagonal or rank-64 divide-and-conquer projected eigensolver could remove that 120 ms; a fused persistent TMA/tcgen05 panel generator can collapse the narrow GEMM/copy train; periodic selective reorth with a stable compact-WY repair remains unmeasured; FP8/NVFP4 A-panel storage with FP32 recurrence correction remains open.

Build a full-spectrum block-Lanczos eigensolver for dense n=512 and n=1024 batches. Generate a complete 32/64-column Krylov basis with BF16/TF32 tensor-core A*V and block recurrences, selective FP32 reorthogonalization or compact-WY/CQR, solve the resulting block-tridiagonal projection, and backtransform with tensor cores. Explore persistent TMA producer/consumer pipelining and residual-driven early cleanup; retain a per-matrix FP32 residual gate and cuSOLVER fallback.

Replaced the dense 512x512 projected solve with an exact scalar-band Givens bulge chase at half-bandwidth 127, accumulated the similarity transform, and used the existing tridiagonal eigensolver. Validation 39/39; shape3 measured 705030.192 us and geomean 30137.812 us. The mathematically correct serial rotation schedule is far slower than the 120 ms cluster projection and establishes the synchronization/rotation baseline.

Stored 129531 Givens pairs instead of accumulating a dense identity transform, updated only one symmetric triangle per rotation, and applied rotations directly to tridiagonal eigenvectors in reverse order. Validation 39/39; shape3 improved from 705030.192 to 468238.241 us, geomean 29186.979 us, but remained far slower than the dense cluster projection.

Narrowed the complete basis from block64 to block32 so the exact projected half-bandwidth falls from 127 to 63. Validation 39/39; reduced band traffic improved shape3 from 468238.241 to 384559.255 us and geomean to 28783.347 us, but the nearly unchanged 128485-rotation eigenvector transform remains a hard floor.

Kept 16 eigenvector columns resident in 32KB shared-memory tiles while replaying all 128485 Givens rotations, eliminating repeated global vector traffic. Validation 39/39, but 20480 one-warp CTAs each replaying the serial chain were issue/occupancy bound: shape3 regressed from 384559.255 to 664421.631 us, geomean 29976.489 us.

Packed the kd63 upper band plus bulge diagonal into 135KB shared memory with bank-conflict padding and restored the global Givens backtransform. Validation 39/39; one CTA/SM residency and 256K block barriers made the reducer slower than the global packed triangle, shape3 435147.491 us and geomean 29036.501 us.

Restored the faster global packed-triangle kd63 reducer and moved the backtransform barrier outside each fixed-p q-chain, exploiting that q-spaced Givens rotations touch disjoint row pairs. Validation 39/39; synchronization batching improved shape3 modestly from 384559.255 to 376981.913 us and geomean to 28721.713 us, showing transform traffic/instruction work dominates barriers.

Narrowed complete panels to block16, reducing the exact scalar half-bandwidth from 63 to 31 while retaining two-pass full-history FP32 reorthogonalization and grouped rotation replay. Validation 39/39; shape3 improved from 376981.913 to 359225.994 us and geomean to 28613.435 us, with extra panel generation offsetting most band savings.

Stored the 128K-rotation eigenvector chain in FP16 while computing each Givens update in FP32, then applied one true-FP32 polar Newton correction. Validation 39/39 but residual margin narrowed; shape3 improved only from 359225.994 to 355772.126 us and geomean to 28560.682 us because conversion/correction offset bandwidth savings.

Moved the one-step polar repair after FP16 Givens replay from true FP32 SIMT to tensor-core TF32, retaining the outer FP32 residual/orthogonality gate. Validation 39/39; shape3 improved from 355772.126 to 350720.998 us and geomean was 28553.309 us, but residual/orthogonality margins remained much worse than full-FP32 replay.

Returned to block64 cluster projection, reorthogonalized against only the latest two panels, and performed full-history reorthogonalization every second panel as a periodic repair. Validation 39/39 through the safety gate; loss among previously accepted panels was not repaired and scale-batch fallback drove shape3 to 376024.699 us, geomean 28682.295 us.

Continuation executed 10 additional validated trials (16-25). Best branch result remains 53c402b2d at 26912.037 us, dense512 163.699 ms: block64 complete basis, two full-history FP32 reorth passes, conditioned CQR2, C=2 cluster projection. Exact scalar-band reduction was mathematically correct but bracketed far slower: initial kd127 Givens 705.030 ms; packed upper triangle/direct reverse replay 468.238 ms; block32 kd63 384.559 ms; grouped disjoint barriers 376.982 ms; block16 kd31 359.226 ms; FP16 replay plus TF32 polar 350.721 ms. Trial24 profile shows the irreducible scalar path at 134.340 ms band chase + 114.733 ms replay before basis work, versus 120.0 ms for the entire dense cluster projection; tridiagonal solve itself was only about 7.8 ms. Shared-tiled replay regressed to 664.422 ms and 135KB persistent shared-band chase to 435.147 ms due occupancy/barriers. Periodic two-panel reorth with full-history repair every second panel fell back, 376.025 ms; final profile shows 119.955 ms cluster plus cuSOLVER sytrd/stedc. Select 53c402b2d, not current HEAD d4c844a3f. Any further structure win needs a blocked compact-WY band reducer or exact rank64 secular merge that avoids O(n^2) scalar rotations; simple persistence, lower precision, and periodic projection are now measured and ruled out.
